summary_en.motivation: To investigate the microstructure and residual stress distribution in selective laser melted H13 tool steel.
summary_en.method: Samples were fabricated by selective laser melting and characterized using microscopy and residual stress measurement techniques.
summary_en.result: The microstructure and residual stress state of the as-built H13 steel were determined.
summary_en.validation: Experimental characterization provided direct validation of microstructural features and stress values.

papers.title: Hydrogels for Biomedical Applications: Cellulose, Chitosan, and Protein/Peptide Derivatives.
papers.abstract: Hydrogels based on polysaccharide and protein natural polymers are of great interest in biomedical applications and more specifically for tissue regeneration and drug delivery. Cellulose, chitosan (a chitin derivative), and collagen are probably the most important components since they are the most abundant natural polymers on earth (cellulose and chitin) and in the human body (collagen). Peptides also merit attention because their self-assembling properties mimic the proteins that are present in the extracellular matrix. The present review is mainly focused on explaining the recent advances on hydrogels derived from the indicated polymers or their combinations. Attention has also been paid to the development of hydrogels for innovative biomedical uses. Therefore, smart materials displaying stimuli responsiveness and having shape memory properties are considered. The use of micro- and nanogels for drug delivery applications is also discussed, as well as the high potential of protein-based hydrogels in the production of bioactive matrices with recognition ability (molecular imprinting). Finally, mention is also given to the development of 3D bioprinting technologies.

llm.relevance_to_user: 这篇论文是水凝胶材料综述，未涉及AI在生物打印中的任何应用。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a materials review with no AI integration, no experimental validation, and does not address any bioprinting workflow stage.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述天然聚合物水凝胶在生物医学中的应用进展。
summary_zh.method: 系统回顾纤维素、壳聚糖、胶原蛋白及多肽水凝胶的研究。
summary_zh.result: 总结了智能响应、形状记忆、微纳米凝胶及3D生物打印等前沿方向。
summary_zh.validation: 纯文献综述，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: This review summarizes recent advances in hydrogels derived from natural polymers for biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: It systematically surveys hydrogels based on cellulose, chitosan, collagen, and self-assembling peptides.
summary_en.result: Key topics include smart stimuli-responsive hydrogels, shape-memory materials, micro/nanogels for drug delivery, and 3D bioprinting.
summary_en.validation: This is a literature review without experimental validation.
